title: Activities, landmarks & events in Malta
intro: Choose one outing around your confirmed event sessions, not an overfilled checklist. Start near Qawra, then compare Ta’ Qali-area sights and farther trips. Dated events are distinguished from year-round attractions, and PC-gaming status conflicts are kept separate from arcade/VR options. Confirm access and return transport before booking.

records.name: AX ODYCY — trip base hotel, Qawra
records.address: Qawra Coast Road, Qawra SPB 1902, Malta
records.hours: No check-in or check-out clock times are published on the pages read: the hotel's FAQ says early check-in and late check-out are handled by the front desk and are subject to room availability, and the property page lists a 24-hour front desk.
records.price range: Not published on the checked page; the traveler's booking and rate were not supplied to this project
records.description: Your supplied base is AX ODYCY, Qawra Coast Road, Qawra SPB 1902, Deluxe sea-view room, 13–19 October 2026. The hotel website independently confirms the Qawra Coast Road property, 24-hour front desk and free Wi-Fi. The room, dates, rate and booking status are traveler inputs, not independently verified reservations.
records.notes: Operator page re-fetched 11 Oct 2026 (facilities, address and contact details: +356 2354 3000, info.odycy@axhotelsmalta.com). On-property dining is recorded separately in data/food.json. Booking terms, room allocation, meal plan and check-in/check-out times come from the traveler's own reservation, which was not available to this project; the site does not assume them. Walking times from the hotel to nearby bus stops were not measured. Fresh homepage read confirms general hotel facilities, not this booking, meal plan, early check-in, late checkout or use of every facility. Ask reception about a safe route to the chosen bus stop and late food options. Hotel FAQ independently re-read in full during integration: https://axhotelsmalta.com/odycy/faqs/?faq=check-in-out . It describes a free in-room safe and Wi-Fi, daily housekeeping with linen every three days, iron/board on request, paid laundry, pool towels from attendants, Minoa Deck on level 11 for adults and Cheeky Monkey Waters across the road for ages 13+. Public areas are described as ramp-accessible with lifts; this is not a personal accessibility assessment. Front-desk meal-plan upgrades depend on length of stay and have a charge. Guest Relations advertises fixed-charge taxis, car rental, pharmacy directions and a paid on-call doctor; actual availability and prices were not tested. The property markets “Deluxe Room with Side Sea View”; keep the traveler’s supplied “Deluxe sea-view” wording and confirm the booked category, allocation and meal plan on the reservation rather than equating the two labels. Contact shown: +356 2354 3000, info.odycy@axhotelsmalta.com. Promotional banners with stale dates are not trip-specific offers.

records.name: Thunderpick CS2 Finals · advertised 14–18 October 2026
records.address: BLAST Arena Studios Malta, MFCC South Gate National Stadium, ATD 4000 Attard, Malta — the venue/address shown on the Eventbrite listing read 11 October. Its map link resolves to coordinates 35.8957343, 14.4168839; neither address nor map point identifies an attendee gate inside the site.

The Sat 17 Oct and Sun 18 Oct entries sit behind a “Show all agenda” control that did not expand in the extracted page, so playoff-day door/game times are not yet confirmed. The listing headline gives 9:30 AM–10:00 PM, while the Wednesday/Thursday agenda rows extend to 22:30; the displayed end times conflict and should be confirmed with the organizer.
records.price range: A free reservation option was advertised on the Eventbrite page read 11 October (“Free / Reserve a spot”); current inventory, reservation status and any later price change were not checked.
records.description: Hotspawn’s Eventbrite listing advertises an in-person, 18+ event at BLAST Arena Studios Malta (MFCC, Attard), 14–18 October, with free reservation. The organizer lists groups on 14–16 October and playoffs on 17–18 October. A listing is not your ticket: reservation, attendee gate and weekend agenda still need confirmation.
records.notes: Primary source read 11 October 2026: the official Eventbrite listing https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/e/hotspawn-present-the-thunderpick-world-championships-2026-tickets-1988838616841 , titled “Hotspawn present the Thunderpick World Championships 2026”, organizer Hotspawn, venue BLAST Arena Studios Malta, MFCC South Gate National Stadium, ATD 4000 Attard, dates Wednesday 14 – Sunday 18 October, 9:30 AM – 10 PM, highlights “4 days 12 hours”, “ages 18+”, “In person”. The same page carries a Google Maps transit link to coordinates 35.8957343, 14.4168839. HLTV reports the free tickets and links to the same listing: https://www.hltv.org/news/45615/thunderpick-world-championship-talent-revealed . Thunderpick’s own release names BLAST Studios Malta and gives 14–18 October: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/thunderpick-world-championship-2026-returns-to-malta-with-1-million-prize-pool-302850221.html . A second Thunderpick-issued release names the eight-team field and is datelined “TA’ QALI, Malta”: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/thunderpick-world-championship-2026-reveals-eight-team-field-for-1-million-malta-finals-302880720.html . The organizer’s tournament page still lists the 12–19 October operational window: https://world-championship.thunderpick.io/2026-finals/ . This listing supersedes the earlier dated “no public ticket sale found” result and the €10.00 precedent from a separate BLAST-run event for what the page displayed on 11 October. Its map link gives a venue coordinate, not an attendee gate; only three of five daily agenda entries were visible, and current inventory, the traveler’s reservation, per-day scanning and access remain open. Still open: the Saturday 17 and Sunday 18 agenda entries, the attendee gate inside the MFCC site, ticket availability and per-day scanning, parking, and on-site catering. See docs/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md. Official rulebook: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1foK6YiQ9nvCwvfTRn9uRZbV1VEKI2Hia/view . Earlier, pre-substitution trade press named the eight qualified teams (Legacy, Falcons, FURIA, BetBoom, 9z, Aurora, PARIVISION, Virtus.pro) and states all finals matches stream on Thunderpick’s Twitch, Kick and YouTube — stream carriage is not radio or ticketed-attendance information: https://g3newswire.com/thunderpick-confirms-eight-team-field-for-1m-malta-finals/ and https://www.hltv.org/news/45525/falcons-and-furia-headline-thunderpick-world-championship-team-list (search views 11 October 2026). Fresh reads in this session confirm the organizer’s stage dates and the Eventbrite visible agenda. The organizer page contains the internally inconsistent line “4 Teams advance to Group Stage” alongside eight teams in groups; do not repeat that apparent typo as format guidance. The free reservation advertisement does not guarantee availability. Integration update: HLTV and Hotspawn reports dated 9 October, freshly read, say NIP replaces Virtus.pro. See the teams/format entry; the older list above is historical, not the final roster.

records.price range: The event page lists €55 per adult, senior, student or child; €45 for Heritage Malta members. Do not assume tickets are available or that the event can proceed while the closure notice is active.

records.notes: The dedicated event page gives the schedule, arrival instruction, description and listed prices: https://heritagemalta.mt/whats-on/picnic-in-the-1800s/. records.name: Malta National Aquarium

records.name: Comino — Blue Lagoon day trip
records.category: Near the Qawra base & north Malta attractions
records.address: Blue Lagoon, Comino, Malta
records.hours: A free landing QR pass is required before stepping ashore in the Blue Lagoon area. Listed slots: 08:00–13:00, 13:30–17:30 and 18:00–22:00. Ferry times are separate and operator-specific.
records.price range: Blue Lagoon landing pass: free. Ferry/boat fare is separate and varies by operator; no trip-specific fare was verified.
records.description: Island / sea excursion: A possible island day trip, subject to the boat operator’s 13–19 October timetable, weather and capacity. The official Blue Lagoon Access Management System says visitors need a free timed QR landing pass to remain ashore in the Lagoon; it is not a ferry ticket.
records.notes: The official AMS FAQ says passes can be booked up to two months ahead, ferry transport must be purchased separately, and authorised-vessel/operator rules apply. Malta’s official tourism ferry directory lists a Paradise Diving service from Ċirkewwa every 30 minutes from 1 May to 31 October, but that directory is not a date-specific sailing confirmation: https://www.visitmalta.com/en/a/ferries-and-water-taxis/. Check the chosen operator and Blue Lagoon booking portal for your exact day.

records.name: Mdina and Rabat historic-centre walk
records.category: Near the event venue — Ta’ Qali, Mosta, Mdina, Rabat & UNESCO heritage
records.address: Mdina and Rabat, Malta
records.hours: No city-wide visitor schedule was published by the official sources checked; museums, the cathedral and other attractions set their own hours.
records.price range: No city-entry price was published by the official sources checked; ticketed attractions are separate.
records.description: A general walk through Mdina and Rabat. Malta’s UNESCO Tentative List entry describes Mdina as a fortified hill-top settlement and says it served as the Islands’ administrative and political capital for almost two millennia; this is a tentative-list entry, not an inscription on the World Heritage List.
records.notes: UNESCO’s Malta-submitted Tentative List entry verifies Mdina’s fortified form and historic role but does not publish visitor hours or prices: https://whc.unesco.org/en/tentativelists/983/.
